SSC CGL Tier 1 in short

SSC CGL Tier 1: 100 questions in 60 minutes (General Intelligence and Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English Comprehension 25). A right answer gets 2 marks and a wrong one loses 0.5; a skipped question costs nothing. One clock runs for the whole paper. That is about 36 seconds a question.

100 questions × 2 marks = 200 marks. One clock for the whole paper: you can move between sections.

In recent cycles Tier 1 has decided who goes on to Tier 2, and the final merit list has come from Tier 2.

How the scoring works

Every wrong answer takes marks away, so a skipped question can be worth more than a guess.

Say you answer 60 right and 16 wrong in the whole paper:

60 × 2 − 16 × 0.5 = 120 − 8 = 112

On average, a blind guess among four options gains about 0.13 of a mark; ruling out two options first raises that to about 0.75 of a mark.

Percentages

What is 12% of 1,180?

  1. 200.6
  2. 1,038.4
  3. 141.6
  4. 82.6
Show the answer and steps

Answer: C. 141.6

  2. = 141.6

Number series

What comes next? 2, 7, 17, 37, 77, ?

  1. 162
  2. 156
  3. 117
  4. 157
Show the answer and steps

Answer: D. 157

  1. Each term is the previous × 2 + 3
  2. So the next term is 157

SSC CGL questions people ask

Is there negative marking in SSC CGL Tier 1?

Yes. 0.5 of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer, and a right answer gets 2 marks. A skipped question costs nothing.

How much time do you get per question in SSC CGL Tier 1?

60 minutes for 100 questions: 36 seconds a question on average. One clock for the whole paper: you can move between sections.

Which sections are in SSC CGL Tier 1?

4 sections: General Intelligence and Reasoning (25 questions), General Awareness (25 questions), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions), English Comprehension (25 questions). 100 questions in all.

How can I practise SSC CGL quant and reasoning every day for free?

On Takkar, each duel gives you ten new questions, five quant and five reasoning, in SSC CGL marking and timing, with step-by-step solutions. It’s free in any browser at playtakkar.in/play, with no sign-up.

Is Takkar an official SSC website?

No. Takkar is an independent practice game and isn’t affiliated with any exam-conducting body. For notices, dates and results, see ssc.gov.in.
